title: AS2 compiler: stack underflow on compound member assignment (_root.ball._x += vx)
description:
Stack underflow reported by Ruffle when running a script with compound assignments on chained member paths like '_root.ball._x += vx'.

The issue is in the AS2 compiler's code generation for CompoundAssignmentExpr (+=, *=, etc.) when the left-hand side is a chained MemberExpression (obj.prop1.prop2).

For simple variable compound assignment (vx *= -1), the pattern is correct:
  GetVariable 'vx', Push -1, Multiply, SetVariable 'vx'

For member compound assignment (obj.prop += val), correct AVM1 sequence is:
  1. Evaluate object expr → [obj]         (will be SetMember's object)
  2. Push property name → [obj, 'prop']   (will be SetMember's name)
  3. Re-evaluate object expr → [obj, 'prop', obj]
  4. GetMember 'prop' → [obj, 'prop', current_val]
  5. Evaluate RHS → [obj, 'prop', current_val, rhs]
  6. Operate (Add/Multiply) → [obj, 'prop', new_val]
  7. SetMember (pops new_val, 'prop', obj) ✓

For nested chains like _root.ball._x, the 'object' is _root.ball and 'prop' is '_x', requiring re-evaluation of the full chain in step 3.

Also check: unary negation in compound assignment (vy *= -bounce) and Math.abs() call.

File: packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/as2/compiler.ts or similar (find the AS2 compiler).

Steps:
1. Find the AS2 compiler source (search for 'SetMember' or 'CompoundAssign' or 'BinaryExpression' in packages/)
2. Find the compound assignment code generation path
3. Fix the member access compound assignment to emit the correct sequence above
4. Run tests: pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run (must stay at 612)
5. Write a unit test for compound member assignment if none exists
